column1: # Declared licence of every centrally-managed NuGet package, one per line: package<TAB>SPDX.
# Enforced by scripts/check-licences.sh, which fails when a package in Directory.Packages.props is
# missing here or carries a licence outside the permitted set. Adding a dependency therefore means
# recording what it is licensed under, which is the point: the tree's "100% MIT" promise is about what
# HexIDE ships, and a dependency whose terms nobody checked is exactly how that promise breaks.
# Values were read from the NuGet registration API's licenceExpression (or its legacy licenseUrl) at the
# pinned version, not from memory. Re-check with that API rather than assuming when bumping a package.
# The permitted set is MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, 0BSD, Unlicense and MS-PL --
# permissive licences compatible with redistributing an MIT product. Copyleft and, importantly,
# NOASSERTION or any unresolved licence are refused: an unknown licence is not a mild finding, it is an
# unbounded one, and it cannot be undone once shipped.
